findings.evidence: features/001-design-skill/001-design-skill-prd.md:89-91 — Requirement R12 ('Self-contained HTML output') traces to 'codebase context (pre-grilling)' rather than to a `Resolved` line from any of the six grilling rounds. Every other requirement (R1-R11) cites a Round-N Resolved line. R12 is the only one that breaks the pattern.
findings.claim: Trace integrity — R12 is a real constraint and the codebase context bullet is real, but the trace pattern the rest of the PRD follows requires a Resolved line per requirement. A reader auditing requirement provenance hits R12 and has to walk back to the codebase context to verify, which is a different surface than the rounds (Surgical Changes, line 'Match existing style').
findings.proposed_change: Either (a) move R12 to a `## Inherited constraints` section that cites the codebase context bullet directly (separate from Requirements, which trace to grilling rounds); or (b) strengthen the trace by adding a sentence to R12: 'Trace: codebase context (pre-grilling) bullet — `adjacent skills: specflow:render already produces self-contained HTML; same convention applies here`. No grilling round was needed because the convention was inherited and pre-confirmed.' Option (b) is the smaller change and preserves the requirement structure.
